name: The Undead
summary: A pact with a deathless being that grants a dreadful form.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.short: Death-themed spells join your warlock list.
features.summary: The Undead adds these spells to the warlock spell list for you; learn them like other warlock spells.

features.name: Form of Dread
features.short: Bonus action: temp HP, immune to fear, and frightening hits.
features.summary: As a bonus action, you transform for 1 minute: gain 1d10 + warlock level temporary hit points, can't be frightened, and once per turn a creature you hit with an attack must make a WIS save or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn. Uses: PB per long rest.

features.name: Grave Touched
features.short: No need to eat, drink or breathe; necrotic damage and +1 die in dread form.
features.summary: You don't need to eat, drink or breathe. Once per turn when you hit with an attack, you can change its damage to necrotic; in your Form of Dread you also roll one extra damage die.

features.name: Necrotic Husk
features.short: Resist necrotic; once per long rest, survive dropping to 0 HP.
features.summary: You have resistance to necrotic damage (immunity while in Form of Dread). When you drop to 0 hit points, you can drop to 1 instead and deal 2d10 + warlock level necrotic damage to creatures within 30 ft. Once per long rest.

features.name: Spirit Projection
features.short: Project your spirit for an hour with special benefits.
features.summary: As an action, your spirit leaves your body for up to 1 hour (concentration): it has resistance to physical damage, can cast conjuration and necromancy spells without components, and can fly at your speed. Once per long rest.
